<script>
(function() {
  // Constants: hardcoded site configuration
  const COOKIE_NAME = 'mktgLanguagePref';
  const LANG_DEFAULT = 'en-us';
  const LANG_FALLBACK = 'en-gb';
  const MATCH_PATHS = ['/', '/sports'];

  // Site mapping: handle -> base URL
  const SITES = {
    'en-us': { primary: true, baseUrl: '/' },
    'en-gb': { primary: false, baseUrl: '/en_gb/' }
  };

  // Language code mappings (e.g., en-ca -> en-us)
  const LANG_MAP = {
    'en-ca': LANG_DEFAULT
  };

  function getCookieValue() {
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (let cookie of cookies) {
      const [name, value] = cookie.trim().split('=');
      if (name === COOKIE_NAME) {
        return decodeURIComponent(value).toLowerCase();
      }
    }
    return '';
  }

  function normalizeLanguage(language) {
    language = language.toLowerCase();
    return LANG_MAP[language] || language;
  }

  function getBrowserLanguage() {
    const navLang = navigator.language;
    if (!navLang) return null;

    const normalized = normalizeLanguage(navLang);

    if (SITES[normalized]) {
      return normalized;
    }

    if (normalized.includes('-')) {
      const langComponent = normalized.split('-')[0];
      for (const siteHandle in SITES) {
        if (siteHandle.startsWith(langComponent)) {
          return siteHandle;
        }
      }
    }

    return null;
  }

  function getRequestedSite() {
    const cookieValue = getCookieValue();
    if (cookieValue && SITES[cookieValue]) {
      return cookieValue;
    }

    const browserLang = getBrowserLanguage();
    if (browserLang) {
      return browserLang;
    }

    return LANG_FALLBACK;
  }

  function isPreventRedirect(targetSite) {
    if (SITES[targetSite].primary) {
      return true;
    }

    if (getCookieValue() === LANG_DEFAULT) {
      return true;
    }

    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (params.has('token') || params.has('ignore-lang')) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  function shouldCheckRedirect() {
    const pathname = window.location.pathname;
    const normalizedPath = pathname === '/' ? '/' : pathname.replace(/\/$/, '');
    return MATCH_PATHS.includes(normalizedPath);
  }

  function checkForRedirect() {
    if (!shouldCheckRedirect()) {
      return;
    }

    const targetSite = getRequestedSite();
    if (isPreventRedirect(targetSite)) {
      return;
    }

    const pathname = window.location.pathname;
    const search = window.location.search;
    const hash = window.location.hash;

    const baseUrl = SITES[targetSite].baseUrl;
    const targetUrl = baseUrl + pathname.replace(/^\//, '') + search + hash;

    window.location.replace(targetUrl);
  }

  checkForRedirect();
})();
</script>

<script>
	(function() {
    function dropdowns(selector) {
      const itemExpandableClass = selector + "__item--expandable";
      const itemExpandedClass = selector + "__item--expanded";
      const hideMobileClass =  selector + "--hide-mobile";
      var mainNavEl = document.querySelector("." + selector);

      // Early return if there is no element to operate on
      if (!mainNavEl) { return; }

      function collapse(el) {
        el.classList.remove(itemExpandedClass);
        el.nextElementSibling.setAttribute("hidden", true);
        el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
        el.nextElementSibling.setAttribute("aria-hidden", true);
      }

      function expand(el) {
        // Collapse siblings
        mainNavEl
          .querySelectorAll("." + itemExpandableClass)
          .forEach((siblingEl) => {
            if (siblingEl !== el) {
              collapse(siblingEl);
            }
          });
        el.classList.add(itemExpandedClass);
        el.nextElementSibling.removeAttribute("hidden");
        el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', true);
        el.nextElementSibling.setAttribute("aria-hidden", false);
      }

      function toggle(el) {
        if (el.classList.contains(itemExpandedClass)) {
          collapse(el);
        } else {
          expand(el);
        }
      }

      function collapseAll() {
        mainNavEl.querySelectorAll("." + itemExpandableClass).forEach((el) => { collapse(el); });
        mainNavEl.classList.add(hideMobileClass);
      }

      // Close dropdown if click event occurs outside of the mainNavEl or if the escape key is pressed
      document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
          if (!mainNavEl.contains(event.target)) {
            collapseAll();
          }
      });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function(event){
        if(event.key === "Escape"){
          collapseAll();
        }
      });

      // Aria Labels
      mainNavEl.querySelectorAll("." + itemExpandableClass).forEach((el) => {
        el.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', true);
        el.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
        el.nextElementSibling.setAttribute("aria-hidden", true);
      });

      // Add click events
      // Mobile hamburger toggle
      mainNavEl.querySelector("." + selector + "__toggle").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        mainNavEl.classList.toggle(hideMobileClass);
      });
      // Dropdown items
      mainNavEl.querySelectorAll("." + itemExpandableClass).forEach((el) => {
        el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggle(e.currentTarget);
        });
      });
    }

    function tabs(selector) {
      const tabExpandableClass = selector + "__tab--expandable";
      const tabExpandedClass = selector + "__tab--expanded";
      var tabbedNavEl = document.querySelector("." + selector);

      // Early return if there is no element to operate on
      if (!tabbedNavEl) { return; }

      let expandableTabs = document.querySelectorAll("." + tabExpandableClass);
      let flyoutMenus = document.querySelectorAll(".subnav__grouped__flyout");

      expandableTabs.forEach((el) => {
        el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          let currentTabData = document.querySelector('.subnav__grouped__flyout[data-content="subnav-' + this.dataset.name + '"]');

          // hide all other flyouts and remove active state
          flyoutMenus.forEach((fl) => {
            if (fl !== currentTabData) {
              fl.classList.remove('show-mobile', 'is-open');
            }
          })

          document.querySelector("." + tabExpandedClass).classList.remove(tabExpandedClass);

          // show selected flyout and add active state
          currentTabData.classList.add('show-mobile', 'is-open');
          currentTabData.getElementsByClassName('subnavitem--icon')[0].focus();
          this.classList.add(tabExpandedClass);
        });
      })

      // wire up mobile close toggles on flyouts
      let closeToggle = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-back-toggle');
      closeToggle.forEach((el) => {
        el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          closeFlyouts();
          let currentTabData = el.closest('.subnav__grouped__flyout[data-content]');
          let lastTab = document.querySelector('.subnav__tabs__tab--expandable[data-name="' + currentTabData.dataset.content.replace('subnav-', '') + '"]');
          lastTab.focus();
        })
      })

      function closeFlyouts() {
        flyoutMenus.forEach((fl) => {
          fl.classList.remove('show-mobile');
        })
      }

      // reset all flyouts if mobile toggle is closed
      document.querySelector(".mainnav__toggle").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        closeFlyouts();
      });

    }



    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function(event) {
      dropdowns('secondary-nav');
      // Sticky Subnavigation
      const subnavigationEl = document.querySelector('.secondary-nav');
      // Early return if there is no element to operate on
      if (!subnavigationEl) { return; }

      const subnavObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
        ([el]) => el.target.classList.toggle("secondary-nav--pinned", el.intersectionRatio < 1),
        { threshold: [1] }
      );
      subnavObserver.observe(subnavigationEl);
    });

    // init dropdowns
    function init() {
      dropdowns('mainnav');
      tabs('subnav__tabs');
    }
    init();

  })();
</script>

/* Lazily fetch and inline svgs =========================== */

const _svgReadyPromises = new Map();

const svgFilename = url => url.split('/').pop();

function whenSvgInlined(filename) {
  if (!_svgReadyPromises.has(filename)) {
    let resolve;
    const promise = new Promise(r => { resolve = r; });
    _svgReadyPromises.set(filename, { promise, resolve });
  }
  return _svgReadyPromises.get(filename).promise;
}

const inlineSvg = async (img) => {
  const url = img.dataset.src;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error();

    const text = await response.text();
    const parser = new DOMParser();
    const svg = parser.parseFromString(text, 'image/svg+xml').querySelector('svg');

    svg.querySelectorAll('image.external').forEach(image => {
      const src = image.getAttribute('href');
      if (src) {
        image.setAttribute('href', `https://sc.hudl.com/cms/assets/images/homepage-2026/${src}`);
      }
    });

    if (svg) {
      Array.from(img.attributes).forEach(attr => {
        if (attr.name !== 'src' && attr.name !== 'data-src') {
          svg.setAttribute(attr.name, attr.value);
        }
      });
      img.replaceWith(svg);
      const key = svgFilename(url);
      if (_svgReadyPromises.has(key)) {
        _svgReadyPromises.get(key).resolve(svg);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    img.src = url; // Fallback
  }
};

const svgObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
  entries.forEach(entry => {
    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
      inlineSvg(entry.target);
      observer.unobserve(entry.target); // Stop watching after loading
    }
  });
}, {
  rootMargin: '100px 0px', // Starts loading 100px before entering viewport
  threshold: 0.01
});

document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]').forEach(img => svgObserver.observe(img));

function initTeamPerformanceVideo() {
  debug('init video controls animation');
  const teamperformanceVideo = document.querySelector("#teamperformance-video");
  const teamperformanceVideoControls = document.querySelector(".hudlui__videocontrols");
  const teamperformanceVideoCurrentTimeDisplay = document.querySelector(".hudlui__videocontrols #currentTime > tspan");
  const teamperformanceVideoTotalTimeDisplay = document.querySelector(".hudlui__videocontrols #totalTime > tspan");

  function formatPlayerTime(time) {
    const m = Math.floor(time / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(time % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const ms = Math.floor(time % 1 * 100).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const frame = Math.ceil((time % 1) * 30).toString().padStart(2, '0');
    return [m, s, frame].join(":");
  }

  if (teamperformanceVideo && teamperformanceVideoControls) {
    teamperformanceVideo.addEventListener("timeupdate", (e) => {
      const progress = e.target.currentTime / e.target.duration;
      teamperformanceVideoControls.style.setProperty('--progress', progress);
      teamperformanceVideoCurrentTimeDisplay.innerHTML = formatPlayerTime(e.target.currentTime);
      teamperformanceVideoTotalTimeDisplay.innerHTML = formatPlayerTime(e.target.duration);
    });
  }

  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger: teamperformanceVideo,
    start: 'top 100%',
    end: 'bottom 0%',
    onToggle: (self) => {
      if (self.isActive) {
        debug('resume team performance video');
        if (self.trigger.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
          self.trigger.play();
        }
      } else {
        debug('pause team performance video');
        if (self.trigger.tagName === 'VIDEO') {
          self.trigger.pause();
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

      y: "+40",
      duration: 3,
      ease: "power3.out",
      stagger: 0.5
    }, "<")
    .to("#operations-visual .visual__bg",
      {
        filter: "brightness(0.5)",
        scale: 0.25,
        duration: 6,
        ease: "power1.out",
      }
    );

  whenSvgInlined('operations-dashboard.svg').then((svg) => {
    debug('init operations dashboard svg animation');
    const dashboardData = {
      highlightViews: 0,
      livestreamViews: 0,
      ticketsSold: 0,
      registrants: 0,
      totalRevenue: 0,
      athletes: 0,
    };
    const highlightsEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #highlight_views_val');
    const livestreamsEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #livestream_views_val');
    const ticketsSoldEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #tickets_sold_val');
    const registrantsEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #registrants_val');
    const totalRevenueEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #total_revenue_val');
    const athletesEl = document.querySelector('#operations-dashboard #athletes_val');

    gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: "#operations-visual",
        start: "top 60%",
        end: "top 0%",
        // scrub: true
      }})
      .fromTo("#operations-dashboard #Dashboard > g",
        {
          filter: "brightness(0.25)",
          opacity: 0
        },
        {
          duration: 1,
          ease: "elastic.out(4,1)",
          filter: "brightness(1)",
          opacity: 1,
          stagger: {
            each: 0.075,
            from: "start"
          }
        })
      .to(dashboardData, {
        highlightViews: 27.9,
        livestreamViews: 10.8,
        ticketsSold: 4.3,
        registrants: 745,
        totalRevenue: 42000,
        athletes: 180,
        duration: 4,
        ease: "power4.out",
        onUpdate: updateDashboard
      }, "<");

      function updateDashboard() {
        highlightsEl.textContent = [dashboardData.highlightViews.toFixed(2), "K"].join('');
        livestreamsEl.textContent = [dashboardData.livestreamViews.toFixed(1), "K"].join('');
        ticketsSoldEl.textContent = [dashboardData.ticketsSold.toFixed(1), "K"].join('');
        registrantsEl.textContent = Math.ceil(dashboardData.registrants);
        totalRevenueEl.textContent = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            style: "currency",
            currency: "USD",
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
          }).format(dashboardData.totalRevenue);
        athletesEl.textContent = Math.ceil(dashboardData.athletes);
      }
  });

  whenSvgInlined('operations-calendar.svg').then((svg) => {
    debug('init operations calendar svg animation');
    gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: "#operations-visual",
        start: "top 60%",
        end: "top 0%",
      }})
      .from("#operations-calendar [id^=Event_]", {
        y: "10",
        opacity: 0,
        duration: 0.25,
        stagger: {
          each: 0.05
        }
      }, "+=1")
  });

  whenSvgInlined('operations-cameras.svg').then((svg) => {
    debug('init operations cameras svg animation');
    gsap.timeline({
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: "#operations-visual",
        start: "top 60%",
        end: "top 0%"
      }})
      .from("#operations-cameras image", {
        scaleY: 0,
        duration: 0.35,
        ease: "power1.out",
        stagger: {
          each: 0.2
        }
      }, "+=0.75")
      .fromTo("#operations-cameras image",
        {
          filter: "brightness(2)",
        }, {
          filter: "brightness(1)",
          duration: 0.75,
          ease: "power1.out",
          stagger: {
            each: 0.25
          }
        }, "<")
  });
} // /#operations

/*
Elements with the data attribute `data-track-progess` get a css variable
that progresses from 0 to 1 as they move frm the bottom to the top of
the viewport
*/
gsap.utils.toArray('[data-track-progress]').forEach(el => {
  el.style.setProperty('--progress', 0);
  gsap.to(el, {
    '--progress': 1,
    ease: 'none',
    scrollTrigger: {
      trigger: el,
      start: 'top bottom',
      end: 'bottom top',
      scrub: true,
    }
  });
});

/*
Elements with the data attribute `data-track-visibility` get a class added
when they are in the viewport.
*/
gsap.utils.toArray('[data-track-visibility]').forEach(el => {
  ScrollTrigger.create({
    trigger: el,
    start: 'top 100%',
    end: 'bottom 0%',
    toggleClass: { targets: el, className: 'is-visible' },
  });
});</script>
